definitions.explanation: Used to introduce the second point in an ordered list of arguments, reasons, or items. Common in speeches, essays, and formal explanations.

examples.japanese: {第二|だいに}に、⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Secondly, there is the issue of cost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{第一|だいいち}に→第一に：19173_daiichini⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧、{第二|だいに}に⟦{効率性|こうりつせい}→効率性：05573_kouritsusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
examples.english: We prioritize safety first and efficiency second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦{第一|だいいち}に→第一に：19173_daiichini⟧…、{第二|だいに}に…、{第三|だいさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧…。
examples.english: There are three reasons for opposing it. First... second... third...

notes:
A formal enumeration marker used in structured arguments. Part of the series ⟦{第一|だいいち}に→第一に：19173_daiichini⟧ (firstly), {第二|だいに}に (secondly), {第三|だいさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (thirdly), and so on.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{第一|だいいち}に→第一に：19173_daiichini⟧…、{第二|だいに}に…: firstly..., secondly...
- {第二|だいに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧…: the second reason is...
- {第二|だいに}に⟦{挙|あ}げられる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧…: what can be cited second is...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: next — less formal; can be sequential rather than hierarchical
- ⟦そして→そして：00997_soshite⟧: and then — conversational connector
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧: also, furthermore — adds without implying a numbered order
- ⟦{二|ふた}つ{目|め}→二つ目：30351_futatsume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as the second item — slightly less formal alternative
